Marian: Queen costume.
Obtained from the Costume Gacha.

lines.text: This time, I will protect everyone.
Were you worried about me? I'm okay now.
I finally know what it is I want to do, and that is why I can win.
I'm so happy to see you again, Commander.
I'm going to make sure everyone can live in a world filled with love. I promise.
I love seeing you smile. Please... always keep smiling.
You'll come back, right, Commander? I know you will.
Take your time. I'll be here protecting this place for when everyone comes back.
Every time I come here, it always feels like I've come home. It's so warm.
Having a place to return to is such a wonderful feeling.
I hope everyone is doing well.
Sorry to keep you waiting. I'll be the one to stand in front of you now, Commander.
My influence has grown even stronger.
Now I'll be able to protect even more things.
Thank you. I will think of this power as another wish I've been entrusted with.
I wonder how much longer I'll be able to receive gifts like this.
I love all of your gifts, Commander.
A gift from the heart always feels so warm. I'll never forget this feeling, no matter where I may be.
Seeing you always makes me happy, Commander.
I love you, Commander. I really do.
The very first place I wanted to come back to was here, next to you. It's the same place I want to protect until the end.
I'll take the lead.
I'm listening.
Come over this way.
So it begins.
I'm not going to lose.
There's no turning back now.
